author: Lucartex
body:
I just wanted to Show you my map and ask you what you think about it.

It Features:

-4 monuments each team
-many treasures
-isn't easy rushable
-two enderpearls in the middle, can be used for one Monument, but it also has to do very much with strategy which Monument you pick


You can now download my world: http://www.mediafire.com/download/01nw4an892rfwj4/Here_And_There.rar

This is a small Album: http://imgur.com/gallery/eBFfG Gosh, accidently made it public

Thx for the feedback!  Yeah, this map took like a week, but I don't know how to write a YML. Pls let me know how to do it!

replies.author: kycrafft
replies.body:
Hmm this looks like a really well made map, but I can't help but think that due to its size it will lead to a lot of running and longer games with less constant action. 

I'm not saying that slower gameplay is a bad thing; I'm glad it won't be rushed in 30 seconds, but I think it may end up as a stalemate just due to its size.

replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body:
I am sorry to say but your map, Here and There, has been denied for testing on the Avicus Network.

To Improve your map, the map developers suggest make it more consistent instead of having weird places stuffed into the map such as giant buildings and underground areas as well as forests. There also needs to be a definite shape to the map as currently, it looks weird.

If you have any other questions on how to improve your map, Find me on TeamSpeak or Message me on Skype (Sethskye).


You may resubmit your map once edited
